subject.title: feat(control-ui): drag sessions into split view with animated drop preview

question: Should Control UI accept this full sidebar-session drag-and-drop split-view model after the i18n and proof blockers are fixed?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-facing chat workspace interaction on a protected maintainer-labeled feature, so automation should not choose the permanent UX contract alone.

options.title: Sponsor After Blockers
options.body: Accept the direction, then require corrected locale output and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow The Gesture
options.body: Ask for a smaller first version, such as center replace or right-split only, before accepting animated four-edge zones.

options.title: Defer The Feature
options.body: Keep the existing header-button and pane selector workflow if the drag/drop complexity is not worth owning now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor After Blockers
recommendation.body: Accept the direction, then require corrected locale output and real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the base split-view work and the linked product request for this exact interaction.
